title: Sign-ins survive resets
summary: A reset never rolls a sign-in back to the golden's older copy. macOS keeps harness logins, browser identities and Safari's cookie store live, and quits Safari before clearing. Linux and WSL ask a running desktop Chromium to quit before clearing, then verify each live Claude, Codex and Cursor login with its sealed real-request probe before clearing and carry verified ones forward. A failing login restores from the golden only if it is unchanged since the seal; otherwise reset refuses test_machine_sign_in_newer_than_baseline before clearing. Save a completed harness sign-in at once with golden-capture. Required Linux teaching additionally keeps desktop Chromium sign-ins live outside all goldens: preserve ~/snap/chromium/common/chromium only when present, never restore its stale golden state, and quit Chromium before preservation to flush it. The unmerged producer commit 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e implements the snap-store exclusion and conditional carry-forward in source. Producer-reported evidence is 29 targeted checks passing, CI run 39040788218 passing, and QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759. These are candidate source checks, not merged delivery or real reset/sign-in proof; those remain pending. Observed status covers source observations, not live verification.
